h1.en: Electric 15 vs the Rural Diesel Pump keeps its own figures; Electric generator is only the picture
h1.zh: 电动15和农村柴油泵有何不同保留自己的数字，「发电机」只是配图

directAnswer.en: Electric 15 and the rural diesel pump are compact concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 15 lists a 15 kW motor, 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m and horizontal 60–80 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_generator.
directAnswer.zh: 电动15和农村柴油泵是河北品锦机械在邢台的紧凑型混凝土泵。电动15标出 15 kW 电机、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_generator。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_generator. The picture shows Modern Steam Turbine Generator. Electric 15 and the rural diesel pump are compact concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Theoretical output: Electric 15 lists 8–10 m³/h. Rural diesel pump lists 5–8 m³/h. Total weight: Electric 15 lists 450 kg. Rural diesel pump lists 800 kg. Electric 15 lists entries that Rural diesel pump does not: Motor power 15 kW. Delivery pipe diameter 100–125 mm. Open /en/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/ for Electric 15 and /en/products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump/ for Rural diesel pump.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_generator。画面是Modern Steam Turbine Generator。电动15和农村柴油泵是河北品锦机械在邢台的紧凑型混凝土泵。垂直输送高度：电动15标出 15–20 m；农村柴油泵标出 10–30 m。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大骨料粒径两边都是 1–3 cm。先看写出的动力是电机还是柴油机，再读那一页自己的距离范围。

body.en: Electric 15 lists a 15 kW motor, 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m and horizontal 60–80 m. Vertical delivery height: Electric 15 lists 15–20 m. Rural diesel pump lists 10–30 m. The same shown value on a shared label: Max. aggregate size is 1–3 cm on both pages. Rural diesel pump lists entries that Electric 15 does not: Diesel engine power 17 kW. Pumping pressure 15 MPa. Hopper capacity 0.2 m³. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 电动15标出 15 kW 电机、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m。水平输送距离：电动15标出 60–80 m；农村柴油泵标出 30–50 m。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看电动15请打开 /zh/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/，看农村柴油泵请打开 /zh/products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump/。

body.en: The rural pump lists 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, horizontal 30–50 m and vertical 10–30 m. Horizontal delivery distance: Electric 15 lists 60–80 m. Rural diesel pump lists 30–50 m. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 农村泵标出 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m。外形尺寸：电动15标出 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm；农村柴油泵标出 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm。电动15有、农村柴油泵没有的行：电机功率 15 kW；输送管内径 100–125 mm。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Aggregate is 1–3 cm on both pages. Dimensions: Electric 15 lists 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. Rural diesel pump lists 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Choose by the shown power line, motor or diesel engine, and then read that page's own range. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 理论输送量：电动15标出 8–10 m³/h；农村柴油泵标出 5–8 m³/h。整机重量：电动15标出 450 kg；农村柴油泵标出 800 kg。农村柴油泵有、电动15没有的行：柴油机功率 17 kW；泵送压力 15 MPa；料斗容积 0.2 m³。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 15 list the same theoretical output as Rural diesel pump?
question.zh: 电动15和农村柴油泵的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 lists 8–10 m³/h. Rural diesel pump lists 5–8 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_generator.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动15标出 8–10 m³/h。农村柴油泵标出 5–8 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_generator画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 15 list the same vertical delivery height as Rural diesel pump?
question.zh: 电动15和农村柴油泵的垂直输送高度一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 lists 15–20 m. Rural diesel pump lists 10–30 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_generator.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动15标出 15–20 m。农村柴油泵标出 10–30 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_generator画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 15 list the same horizontal delivery distance as Rural diesel pump?
question.zh: 电动15和农村柴油泵的水平输送距离一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 lists 60–80 m. Rural diesel pump lists 30–50 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_generator.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动15标出 60–80 m。农村柴油泵标出 30–50 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_generator画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is motor power missing on Rural diesel pump?
question.zh: 为什么农村柴油泵没有电机功率？

answer.en: The Rural diesel pump page does not list that label. Electric 15 lists 15 kW. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_generator.
answer.zh: 农村柴油泵这一页没有标出这个标题。电动15标出的是 15 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_generator画面里印出的数字。
